review.note: Wikidata Q1616739 gives P361 "Arauco War", and the cached English lead at revision 1370587425 says instead that the battle "is an antecedent of the Arauco War" — which this atlas dates 1546-1662, ten years later. So the P361 filing was refused and the umbrella written here is the one that fits by span and subject: Spanish conquistadors against the Mapuche in Chile in 1536 is inside the Spanish colonization of the Americas, 1493-1898.

title: Battle of Reynogüelén (1536)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Reynogüelén (1536)", at revision 1370587425, opens: "The Battle of Reynogüelén took place between Spanish conquistadors and Mapuche soldiers, thought to have occurred near the confluence of the Ñuble and Itata Rivers, in Chile. This battle is an antecedent of the Arauco War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1616739, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1536 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
